dedupeText: mid 1960s folk rock album cover aesthetic 1960s grunge distressed folk rock woodblock type sepia band portrait oversized header typography framing a smaller secondary title block low angle group portrait set against dark textured negative space heavy surface distressing and ring wear unifying the image and text high contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on faces combine high contrast industrial photography with oversized jagged woodblock type and heavy analog surface distress for a mid 60s rock aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast 1960s album cover featuring a group portrait in a derelict industrial setting, dominated by massive, distressed woodblock-style lettering at the top and a heavy texture of age-related wear and scratches.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized header typography framing a smaller secondary title block
Low-angle group portrait set against dark, textured negative space
Heavy surface distressing and 'ring wear' unifying the image and text
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on faces
coreInvariants: Heavy artificial aging and surface scratches

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Band members occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, arranged in a staggered, informal group pose within a dark interior.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, black, blocky display text at the top edge of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the heavy top text, drops to the high-contrast faces of the subjects, and settles on the textured debris at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark industrial backgrounds serve as negative space to make the subjects and white/red text pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and primary text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and cream for highlights and background textures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted brick red for secondary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between deep blacks and blown-out highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to sepia-toned neutrals and one muted accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and woodblock grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Irregular, hand-cut edges suggesting woodblock printing
Inconsistent stroke widths and intentional 'ink bleed' effects
Heavy, blocky serifs on the display type
Tight, overlapping letter spacing in the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' and 'E' characters feature exaggerated, jagged serifs
Inner counters are small and irregular

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single line split by secondary text

composition.position: Upper center, nested in display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Massive black woodblock type paired with smaller, stacked red slab-serif type for contrast in scale and color.
graphicDevices: Circular bullet points between metadata text

preserve: The jagged, hand-cut feel of the large text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the jagged, western-influenced woodblock aesthetic
Appropriate for the secondary slab-serif text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of five men in 1960s mod clothing standing in a dark, ruined warehouse with debris on the floor. Apply a heavy sepia tint and intense surface scratches, dust, and circular ring wear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive, jagged black woodblock lettering across the top. In the center gap of the large text, add three lines of smaller, stacked, muted red slab-serif text. Below the main title, add a horizontal line of small, bold black serif text separated by bullets.

verificationChecks: Is the top text sufficiently jagged and distressed?
Does the image have a visible 'ring wear' texture?
Is the color palette limited to cream, black, and muted red?
Is the photography high-contrast and grainy?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
Specific font weight of the metadata line
mustRedesign: Any specific band names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ink bleed' effect on large letters
Ensure the ring wear looks like physical cardboard damage
Verify the high-contrast lighting on faces
Confirm the text layout follows the nested hierarchy
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast industrial photography with oversized, jagged woodblock type and heavy analog surface distress for a mid-60s rock aesthetic.
